title: Data export writes no sys_audit_log row and the `export` action value is retired, so no export of any object (the audit ledger included) can be audited
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Filing gate: **(b) a contract gap with a named consumer**. The cloud#3665 dev measured it (report 6686540441 on objectstack-ai/cloud#3665, Enterprise P2-4). The maintainer ruled on that card 「企业版授权，用平台导出（推荐）」: the Enterprise audit-export is a licensed permission set over **this framework's export door**, so the door itself has to record the export. Platform gaps go to the platform (「平台的问题应该在平台处理」, objectstack#30765). Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#3665's export PR, which waits on this card.

## 维护者速读

现在通过平台的「导出」（`GET /data/:object/export`，csv/xlsx/json）导出任何对象的数据，审计日志里都不会留下一条记录；审计日志的动作枚举里也已经没有 `export` 这个值（#8147 因为"从来没人写"把它退役了）。企业版要求"导出审计日志这件事本身也要被审计"，所以需要平台在导出门上写一条审计记录，并把 `export` 值和写入方一起恢复。

## Measured (objectstack `6ddf827236`)

- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-audit-log.object.ts:289` retired `export` from the `action` enum under ADR-0087 (#8147, ruling 2026-08-12), because nothing wrote it. The `:244` view filter dropped it too.
- `packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts:1096` (`GET /data/:object/export`, the streaming export) writes no `sys_audit_log` row.
- On a real objectos-ee boot the door answers `403 EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED` on `sys_audit_log` until `allowExport` is granted. So the permission gate works; only the record is missing.

## Expected

- One `sys_audit_log` row per completed export, for **every object** (not just the ledger), in the same PR as the restored `export` enum value. ADR-0087's 宁窄勿谎 rule allows a value only together with its writer.
- The row carries:
  - actor and user
  - object
  - format
  - row count
  - truncation (the 50k cap)
  - the filter / query as a bounded summary that never includes cell values
  - outcome
- A refused export (`EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED`) records either nothing or a refusal row. Say which, and why.
- Follow the incumbent run-level shape (`record_id: null`, as `plugin-auth`'s `admin-import-users.ts` `import` row does) unless the lane judges otherwise.

## Acceptance

- Tests:
  - An export of an ordinary object writes one row with format and count.
  - An export of `sys_audit_log` writes one row.
  - A truncated export records the truncation.
  - The row never carries an exported cell value.
- The ADR-0087 / #8147 comments at `sys-audit-log.object.ts:244` and `:289` are updated in the same PR.

Suggested-grade: p1 · Enterprise priority (maintainer, 「cloud 多了几个企业版的任务，优先处理」).

Dedupe (2026-11-06): `export audit row` → 1815 hits, top 5 none (#30924 is sign-in refusals); `audit export action` → 956, top 5 none; `data export audited` → 140, top 5 none (all closed, unrelated); `export sys_audit_log` → 116, top 5 none (#24899 is the archive copy, closed). None covers this gap.
